in_hindi.name: भूपेन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: पृथ्वी (pṛthvī) - Earth के (ke) - with साथी (sāthī) - friend

in_marathi.name: Bhoopendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoopendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhoo (Earth) + Ish (Lord) + Pendra (Protector) This name signifies the protector of the earth or the ruler of the earth.

in_bengali.name: Bhoopendra

in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhoopendra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhoo (Earth) + Ish (Lord) + Pendra (Protector) This name signifies the protector of the earth or the ruler of the earth.
